constantes.ENTRAINEMENT_PARAGRAPHES.0: Located at the heart of the estate, a few steps from the club house, the Château l'Arc driving range welcomes you every day to warm up before your round or for a proper practice session, with a view of the Sainte-Victoire mountain.
constantes.ENTRAINEMENT_PARAGRAPHES.1: Its [XX] bays, [XX] of them covered so you can play in any weather, let you work on your long game from mats or grass [to be confirmed]. A bucket of balls costs €4 — and €3 with a green fee or for members.
constantes.ENTRAINEMENT_PARAGRAPHES.2: Nearby, a chipping green surrounded by bunkers helps you perfect your short game: bunker shots, chips and pitch-and-runs. A putting green completes the facilities so you can find your touch before tackling the par 70 designed by Robert Trent Jones II.
constantes.ENTRAINEMENT_PARAGRAPHES.3: This is also where the Academy's golf school and the club teams train, coached by our state-qualified instructors.
constantes.EXPLORER_TEXTE: Choose a hole to see its video, its layout and the pro's tip.
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.0.question: Which memberships do you offer?
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: Individual €2,280, Couple €3,732, Family (2 adults) €3,732, Individual under 35 €1,560, Couple under 35 €2,748, Under 25 & students €984, Under 15 €540, Individual over 80 €2,052, Couple over 80 €3,300, per year.
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.1.question: Is there a discount for paying in full?
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Yes: 5% off when paying in full until 31/12.
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.2.question: Can I pay my membership in instalments?
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: Contact reception to find out the payment terms for your membership.
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.3.question: How do I become a member?
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.3.reponse: Apply online or at reception: the team will help you choose the right membership.
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.4.question: What is the golf association?
constantes.FAQ_ABONNEMENTS_QUESTIONS.4.reponse: The golf association (Association sportive) runs club life: competitions, matches and events between members throughout the season.
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.0.question: From what age can you learn?
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: From age 4, at the junior golf school: ages 4–7 €310 per year (1h30 per week), ages 7 and up €410 per year (2 hours per week), on Wednesdays and Saturdays.
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.1.question: Do you offer lessons for adults?
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Yes, the Prestige programmes: group lessons of up to 6 people, one hour a day, on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays, from €90 per month.
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.2.question: Are there courses during the holidays?
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: Yes, courses for all levels are organised during the school holidays and all year round.
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.3.question: Can we organise a taster session?
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.3.reponse: Yes, from 2 to 30 people, with friends, family or colleagues. Book by phone with reception.
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.4.question: Who are the instructors?
constantes.FAQ_ACADEMIE_QUESTIONS.4.reponse: Julien Lefevre and Arnaud Bonnard, state-qualified golf instructors.
constantes.FAQ_ACCES_QUESTIONS.0.question: Where is the golf course?
constantes.FAQ_ACCES_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: Domaine Château l'Arc, 13710 Fuveau, France, on the doorstep of Aix-en-Provence.
constantes.FAQ_ACCES_QUESTIONS.1.question: How do I get there?
constantes.FAQ_ACCES_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: The estate is 25 minutes from Marseille Provence Airport and Aix-en-Provence TGV station, and 5 minutes from the A8 motorway.
constantes.FAQ_ACCES_QUESTIONS.2.question: How can I contact reception?
constantes.FAQ_ACCES_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: By phone on +33 4 42 29 83 41 or by email at golf@chateaularcgolfclub.com.
constantes.FAQ_COMPETITIONS_QUESTIONS.0.question: How do I enter a competition?
constantes.FAQ_COMPETITIONS_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: From the Competitions page: choose the competition, then use the “Enter” button as soon as entries open.
constantes.FAQ_COMPETITIONS_QUESTIONS.1.question: Are competitions open to visitors?
constantes.FAQ_COMPETITIONS_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Some are: they are marked “Open to all”. The “Open to visitors” filter on the Competitions page groups them together.
constantes.FAQ_COMPETITIONS_QUESTIONS.2.question: Where can I see the results?
constantes.FAQ_COMPETITIONS_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: Official rankings are published as PDFs the day after each competition.
constantes.FAQ_CONTACT_CANAUX.0.texte: Golf reception will answer your questions.
constantes.FAQ_CONTACT_CANAUX.2.texte: Membership, lessons or events: the right team will get back to you.
constantes.FAQ_CONTACT_TITRE: Our team is here for you
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.0.question: Is the golf course open to non-members?
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: Yes. The course is open to all golfers, members or not. Simply book a tee time online or at reception and pay a green fee.
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.1.question: Is a minimum level required to play?
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: A green card or a handicap is required to play the course. For beginners, the Academy offers taster sessions led by our instructors.
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.2.question: How long does an 18-hole round take?
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: Allow on average four to four and a half hours for 18 holes.
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.3.question: How can I check course conditions before coming?
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.3.reponse: Reception updates the status of the course, buggies and facilities every morning. It is shown at the top of the site: click on “Course open” for details.
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.4.question: Is there a dress code?
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.4.reponse: Yes: proper golf attire is required on the course and the driving range.
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.5.question: Who designed the course?
constantes.FAQ_GOLF_QUESTIONS.5.reponse: Robert Trent Jones II, one of the world's greatest golf course architects, in 1985. The course is a 5,817-metre par 70.
constantes.FAQ_PRACTICE_QUESTIONS.0.question: How much is a bucket of balls?
constantes.FAQ_PRACTICE_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: 1 bucket of balls: €4 (€3 for members); 5 buckets: €18 (€12 for members); 10 buckets: €34 (€22 for members); 25 buckets: €75 (€50 for members).
constantes.FAQ_PRACTICE_QUESTIONS.1.question: Can I hire equipment?
constantes.FAQ_PRACTICE_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Yes: push trolley: €5; full set of clubs (hire): €40.
constantes.FAQ_PRACTICE_QUESTIONS.2.question: Are buggies always allowed?
constantes.FAQ_PRACTICE_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: It depends on course conditions. Every morning, reception shows whether they are allowed at the top of the site (“Course open”).
constantes.FAQ_RAPIDE_TEXTE: Golf reception will answer you by phone.
constantes.FAQ_RECHERCHE_EXEMPLE: Search: green fee, buggy, junior lessons…
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.0.question: How do I book a tee time?
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: Online, at any time, with the “Book a tee time” button, or by phone with reception on +33 4 42 29 83 41.
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.1.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Contact reception on +33 4 42 29 83 41: they will explain the conditions for changes or cancellations.
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.2.question: Can I book for a group?
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: Yes. For a group, a company outing or an event, contact reception to arrange your tee times.
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.3.question: Can I come and play on my own?
constantes.FAQ_RESERVATIONS_QUESTIONS.3.reponse: Yes. Simply book a tee time online or at reception.
constantes.FAQ_RESTAURANT_QUESTIONS.0.question: Is the restaurant open to non-golfers?
constantes.FAQ_RESTAURANT_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: Contact the restaurant directly for opening hours and to book a table.
constantes.FAQ_RESTAURANT_QUESTIONS.1.question: Can I enjoy the terrace?
constantes.FAQ_RESTAURANT_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: The large Club House terrace offers a panoramic view of the Sainte-Victoire mountain.
constantes.FAQ_SEMINAIRES_QUESTIONS.0.question: Can the estate be hired privately?
constantes.FAQ_SEMINAIRES_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: Yes, for a seminar, a corporate golf day, a party or a reception. Send your request via the Contact page.
constantes.FAQ_SEMINAIRES_QUESTIONS.1.question: What services do you offer?
constantes.FAQ_SEMINAIRES_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Château function rooms, catering and golf taster sessions: the team will put together a tailor-made proposal with you.
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.0.question: What are the green fee rates?
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.0.reponse: 18 holes: €85 all year round. 9 holes: €55 in high season (from 16 April to 14 November) and €45 in low season (from 15 November to 15 April).
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.1.question: Are there green fee books?
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.1.reponse: Yes, valid for 12 months: 6 rounds of 18 holes for €350, 12 rounds of 18 holes for €700, 12 rounds of 9 holes for €450.
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.2.question: How much does it cost to hire a buggy?
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.2.reponse: Buggy for 18 holes: €40 (€28 for members); buggy for 9 holes: €33 (€25 for members).
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.3.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.3.reponse: Reception will tell you which payment methods are accepted on site.
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.4.question: Can I give a green fee as a gift?
constantes.FAQ_TARIFS_QUESTIONS.4.reponse: Yes, contact the club reception for any gift request.
constantes.FRISE_CHAPITRES.0.texte: The Château l'Arc is built, the centrepiece of the estate, in the heart of true Provence.
constantes.FRISE_CHAPITRES.1.texte: The château becomes the favourite studio of the painter Bernard Buffet, then the summer retreat of Pierre Bergé, Jean Cocteau and Yves Saint Laurent.
constantes.FRISE_CHAPITRES.2.texte: Fernandel shoots “Les Grandes Manœuvres” here. Scenes from the film about Yves Saint Laurent, Les Tuche 2 and Divorce Club followed.
constantes.FRISE_CHAPITRES.3.texte: The 18-hole course wraps around the château, offering magnificent views of the Sainte-Victoire.
constantes.FRISE_CHAPITRES.4.texte: A Club House in the historic residence, a restaurant, receptions and the Sainte-Victoire International School: the estate is alive all year round.
constantes.HISTOIRE_BANNIERE_TEXTE: Four centuries of history at the foot of the Sainte-Victoire: a family residence, an artists' studio, a film set and today a golf course.
constantes.HISTOIRE_INTRO_CITATION: “Built in 1620 by the d'Agoult family, the Château l'Arc is the heart of an estate of more than one hundred hectares, facing the Sainte-Victoire.”
constantes.HISTOIRE_INTRO_PARAGRAPHES.0: On the doorstep of Aix-en-Provence and Marseille, the estate welcomes its visitors in an exceptional setting. The residence now houses the golf Club House: a grand lounge, a bar and a large terrace with a panoramic view of the Sainte-Victoire.
constantes.HISTOIRE_INTRO_PARAGRAPHES.1: The 18-hole course designed by Robert Trent Jones II wraps around the château, and the estate is alive all year round: restaurant, receptions, private parties, concerts and an international school.

constantes.INFOS_CARTES.1.texte: Summer and winter hours: please check with reception before your visit.
constantes.INFOS_CARTES.2.texte: €40 for 18 holes, booking required. Use depends on course conditions.
constantes.INFOS_CARTES.3.texte: Proper golf attire required on the course and the driving range.
constantes.INFOS_NOTE: Course conditions are updated every morning by reception: check them before you come.
constantes.PARCOURS_ATOUTS.0.texte: One of the world's greatest golf course architects, in 1985.
constantes.PARCOURS_ATOUTS.0.titre: Designed by Robert Trent Jones II
constantes.PARCOURS_ATOUTS.1.texte: The mountain so dear to Cézanne accompanies your round, hole after hole.
constantes.PARCOURS_ATOUTS.2.texte: A technical and varied course, demanding for good players, accessible to all.
constantes.PARCOURS_DESCRIPTION: The course winds through unspoilt countryside, among umbrella pines, garrigue and vineyards, with the Sainte-Victoire as a backdrop.
constantes.PARCOURS_PAGE_BANNIERE_ACCROCHE: 18 holes among pines and garrigue, facing the Sainte-Victoire mountain.
constantes.PARCOURS_PAGE_BANNIERE_TEXTE: 18 holes · par 70 · 5,817 m, designed by Robert Trent Jones II among pines, garrigue and the Sainte-Victoire.
constantes.PARCOURS_PRESENTATION_PARAGRAPHES.0: Designed in 1985 by Robert Trent Jones II, one of the world's greatest golf course architects, the Château l'Arc course winds among pines, oaks and garrigue on the château estate. Shaped fairways, strategic bunkers and well-guarded greens, in the purest tradition of American golf.
constantes.PARCOURS_PRESENTATION_PARAGRAPHES.1: From the tees, the view opens onto the Sainte-Victoire mountain, so dear to Cézanne. A technical yet accessible course, where every level of player finds enjoyment thanks to six sets of tees.
constantes.PARCOURS_TITRE: Among pines and garrigue, a course with character
constantes.PRESENTATION_SURTITRE: The finest golf course between Aix and Marseille
constantes.PRESENTATION_TEXTE: Château l'Arc Golf Club is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful golf venues in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region. Opened in 1985 and designed by Robert Trent Jones II, the course is ideally located on the doorstep of Aix-en-Provence and Marseille. This 5,817-metre par 70 offers a varied golfing experience, winding among pines and garrigue in an exceptional setting with a breathtaking view of the Sainte-Victoire mountain.

constantes.PROFITER_CARTES.1.texte: Unlimited access to the course, competitions, driving range and club life all year round.
constantes.PROFITER_CARTES.2.texte: Private lessons, courses for children and adults, preparation for the green card.
constantes.PROFITER_DESCRIPTION: Visiting player, future member or beginner: every golfer finds their place at Château l'Arc.
